chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'adah ibn Sadah, from Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, that Ali (peace be upon him) said:
"When a child is born in the land of war, a share is allocated for him from the spoils (fay') that Allah has granted them."

key_terms.أَرْضِ الْحَرْبِ: Land of war, referring to territories under conflict or not yet fully pacified.
key_terms.أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ: Spoils of war (fay'), specifically the property acquired without direct combat.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on distributing war spoils to newborns born in the land of war?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the status of newborns in *fay'* (booty) distribution, asserting that a child born in enemy territory is entitled to a share upon the community's division of spoils. This ruling underscores the Shia juristic view that birth in the conquered land establishes a right to the collective gain, ensuring the newborn's financial inclusion in the war's outcome. It reflects the practical application of Quranic principles regarding the distribution of *fay'* to all eligible participants, including those who may not have actively fought.
